# Panaceamed AI contribution instructions

The canonical repository instructions are in `/AGENTS.md`.
Before material changes, follow its authority order and read the Product Maturity OS and living governance registries it references.

Default behavior:
- mature and integrate before expanding;
- preserve canonical patient state and provenance;
- prefer complete vertical workflows over isolated components;
- do not fabricate implementation, test, clinical-validation, or evidence status;
- update living registries when architecture/maturity/risk materially changes.
